issues.detail: The skill does not cover error handling or edge cases for data processing.
The documentation contains verbose sections that could be trimmed for brevity.

scenarios.name: responsive-line-chart
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets the 750 ms duration requirement (though it lacks the specified easeCubicInOut), whereas Response A uses a 2000 ms transition and also omits the easing function, making B slightly more compliant.

scenarios.name: force-directed-graph
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully implements all rubric items, while Response A is incomplete and lacks key features.

scenarios.name: choropleth-map
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes a D3 setup with tooltip but omits the required projection, path, and color scale; Response B uses Plotly, not D3, and thus fails the rubric entirely.
